Stewardesses call it... (and so will you!)
"The world's most luxurious jetliner!"
Stewardesses, always concerned with your comfort aloft, vote
the Douglas DC-8 the world's most luxurious jetliner!
"Lounges like private clubs!" "Wide aisles!" "Everything
is big!" These are just a few of their typical comments.
On your first DC-8 flight you'll see, too, the many unusual
Douglas touches. Restful lighting built into your seat! Service
buttons right at hand. A real table-not a tray—that's in
position at a finger's flick. And in the DC-8 you'll enjoy that
famous feature of Douglas aircraft-peace of mind. You'll
agree "It's the world's most luxurious jetliner!"
More airlines have chosen the DC-8 than any other jeliner:
